papers.title: Quadrantcode Mock OA 01
papers.instructions: A timed online-assessment practice paper built entirely from original Quadrantcode problems. It is not modelled on, or endorsed by, any employer, and none of its questions is a past paper. Four questions — one easy, two medium, one hard — in 90 minutes, on a server-side clock. Run Code uses the visible or your own cases; Submit Question uses the complete protected test set. Only server-verified submissions count towards the score.

provenance.author: Quadrantcode editorial team
provenance.note: Assembled from Quadrantcode-original problems as a general online-assessment practice paper; names no company.
